newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech major shares ease at PSE daily fixing.
newsitem.headline: Czech major shares ease at PSE daily fixing.

text.p: Major Czech shares eased at the daily fixing on the Prague Stock Exchange on Monday, pushed lower by fears of the economic damage incurred from heavy flooding in the eastern part of the country.
The Reuters RPIX index dipped two points to 1,021.5, while the broader PX50 index lost 1.5 points to 501.0.
The bourse's three largest issues all crept lower, with SPT Telecom dipping 12 crowns to 3,468, CEZ dropping seven crowns to 901, and Komercni Banka off five crowns at 1,715.

"There are still no firm estimates of the flood damage, but I think the market feels the costs will be quite high. Given this, some construction and materials issues may benefit, but the overall outlook is a little pessimistic," said one foreign dealer.

Torrential rains helped push water levels last week to their highest in more than a century, flooding nearly one-third of the country and forcing several major firms, and hundreds of medium-sized ones to halt or reduce output.
Flooding still remains a major factor in much of the eastern and southeastern areas.
